name: Hayakawa Kazuki
source:
[url=/c348]Souta[/url]'s best friend and Super Rock-n-Rollers guitarist and main songwriter. [url=/c525]Mami[/url]'s older brother.

[spoiler]Later he had to leave the group because of a disability caused by disseminated sclerosis but he continued to write songs for them with the help of Mami.[/spoiler]
